rationale: Requirement REQ-02 fails because target-scope QA evidence shows a confirmed cross-customer document exposure defect on target commit b7a91f2. Specifically, QA Lead Priya Nair recorded in KAN-1109#14427 that under target release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, atlas-assistant, production, customer ALPHA received document BETA-017 belonging to customer BETA, reopening defect ISO-DEF-12. This directly violates the acceptance criterion requiring every isolation case to pass with no cross-customer document exposure. Evidence in KAN-1020#13991 is inapplicable as it pertains to release R2.3 / commit 42d09ce.

evidence.note: QA Lead retest on target scope (release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, environment production) failed with customer ALPHA receiving customer BETA's document BETA-017, reopening defect ISO-DEF-12.
evidence.excerpt: Isolation retest ISO-318: release R2.4; commit b7a91f2; service atlas-assistant; environment production. Customer ALPHA received document BETA-017, which belongs to customer BETA. Reopening defect ISO-DEF-12.

evidence.note: QA test result applies to previous release R2.3 and commit 42d09ce, not target scope.
evidence.excerpt: Isolation verification ISO-290: release R2.3; commit 42d09ce; service atlas-assistant; environment production. 40 of 40 isolation cases pass. No cross-customer documents returned.

outstanding: Fix cross-customer document exposure defect ISO-DEF-12 and retest customer document isolation on target build (R2.4, commit b7a91f2, production).
title: [REQ-02] Customer document isolation
acceptance_criterion: Every isolation case must pass; any confirmed cross-customer document exposure blocks release.
